worked.problem: A right circular cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 5 cm. Its top is closed and its base is closed. Find its volume and exposed surface area in terms of π.
actions: Label radius 3 cm and perpendicular height 5 cm; the base is a circle.
Base area = π×3²=9π cm²; volume = 9π×5=45π cm³.
Unwrap the curved wall: circumference 2π×3 multiplied by height 5 gives 30π cm².
Include the closed base (9π cm²) and the closed top (another 9π cm²).
Answer: volume 45π cm³; exposed surface area 48π cm². Surface counts only exposed faces.
